subject: Trump pulls Nvidia's CEO out of the logo, hearts flying
alt: Subhani’s cartoon: at the centre, Nvidia’s green logo lies flat on the ground, and a pool of blue water has gathered inside its circular arrow; Jensen Huang, white-haired and bespectacled, in black clothes, stands half submerged in it. At right, Donald Trump, in a black suit and a red tie, runs and grips his hand to pull him out; two red hearts float in the air between them, and clouds of dust rise behind Trump’s feet. A green chip lies at the upper left corner and another at the lower right. A box at the lower right reads: ‘JENSEN HUANG REINSTATED AS NVIDIA CEO’. The signature ‘Subhani’ is at the lower left.
chutki: Trump hauls Jensen Huang out of the water in the middle of Nvidia's green logo, hand in hand, with hearts flying between them. The box says Huang is Nvidia's CEO again.
The needle: the command of one of the world's most valuable companies is not settled in the boardroom alone. In the drawing the way back runs through the heart, and the heart is where the power is.
